source.note: Seeded by #1201 from the 2026-06 hand audit's verdicts so /review-stack-audit has a real baseline before #1199 lands. When #1199 produces its decision record, it replaces this file's `tools` array and sets provenance to "decision-record" with `record` pointing at the new document. Values here record what the 2026-06 audit CONCLUDED, deliberately not what is true today — a baseline pre-loaded with today's reality would suppress the very drift the audit exists to find.

tools.notes: Primary findings engine: 198 inline findings, sole provider on 8 PRs. gates_merge is false on purpose — the 2026-06 audit found 0 APPROVED reviews in 63 PRs and concluded it is a finder, not an approver. Marking it as gating would fire a permanent, false D4 every run. Plan observed as Pro. No rate-limit caps were recorded in the 2026-06 window, so any that appear now are genuine D3 drift.

The de-facto approver — 179 APPROVED across all 63 PRs — and the tool the CR merge-gate path leans on. Its 100-PR free trial was already exhausted at the 2026-06 audit, which observed trial-limit / no-subscription warnings on 19 PRs; both cap kinds are therefore expected, not news. The pending plan decision ($10 Basic vs $24 Premium) is why `billed` is still "trial" rather than "paid".

Highest-precision tool: 99 inline findings, sole provider on 2 PRs, reliable completion signal. $40/mo. gates_merge is true — a clean BugBot pass on current HEAD satisfies the merge gate alone on its path — but approves_via is "check_run", because it signals that pass through the `Cursor Bugbot` check-run and posts no APPROVED review object. Driving D4 off gates_merge would flag that as a missing approval every single run. No spend or usage cap was recorded in the 2026-06 window, so a spend_limit appearing now is genuine D3 drift on a paid tool that can gate the merge.

Demoted to dormant emergency-only: 4 PRs in the first 2 days, then 0 in ~8 weeks, never a sole finding-provider. The 2026-06 audit RECOMMENDED cancelling the $30/seat/mo subscription, but cancellation is a billing action outside the repo and was never confirmed here. `billed` stays "paid" deliberately: if the seat is still live, D2 fires and asks the question; if it was cancelled, the answer is one comment plus a baseline edit to "cancelled". Failing toward surfacing is the correct direction for a recurring charge.
Free parallel advisory on Hobby: 15 precise inline findings across 9 PRs at $0. Never a sole finding-provider, so it is confirmation rather than coverage — explicitly kept out of the merge gate.
Zero activity under any login in the 2026-06 window. This repo is agent configuration, not a Vercel app. Kept disabled / Vercel-only.
